verdict.rationale: Bolt integrates with Supabase, which explicitly provides 'Authentication services' that could be used to scaffold sign-up/login (bolt-docs-22, bolt-docs-27), but there is no direct evidence of Bolt itself generating email/social-provider auth UI or flows, and community feedback notes Supabase is an outsourced backend dependency rather than a native Bolt feature (bolt-comm-11). missing for 10: explicit documentation or example of Bolt scaffolding sign-up/login pages with social provider options, first-party confirmation of social OAuth support, and independent hands-on evidence of successful auth implementation.
